_comment: Complete mlai-trade config template. Copy to ~/mlai-trade/config/mlai-trade.json and replace placeholders. Never commit the real mlai-trade.json file. The runtime config, config examples, data files, DB files, logs, and sockets are kept private by the CLI: sensitive directories are chmod 0700 and sensitive files are chmod 0600. PID files are runtime metadata and chmod 0644.

providers._comment: Enable at least one provider. Alpaca is implemented today. Use providers.other as the generic enablement map for future provider modules.

accounts._comment: A paper account. Paper accounts obey IRS rule simulation in a separate paper compliance universe.
accounts.name: paper-main

accounts._comment: Example real-money account. Real accounts share IRS/tax compliance blockers across all real provider accounts.
accounts.name: individual-main

fred._comment: FRED API key for S&P 500/VIX/macro features.

tax._comment: Federal tax estimate inputs. filing_status: single, married_filing_jointly, married_filing_separately, or head_of_household. estimated_annual_income is treated as estimated annual taxable ordinary income before trading gains. Paper accounts are excluded from tax estimates by default. brackets_file contains all IRS bracket/rate data and should be updated by JSON diff when IRS publishes a new year.

daemon._comment: Daemon mode runs auto-trade cycles, tax refresh, and daily non-trading prep. start refuses unless enabled=true. daily_refresh_trigger=market_close runs prep once per open market date after regular_close + daily_refresh_after_close_minutes. daily_refresh_trigger=time uses daily_refresh_time as the trigger/fallback. auto_trade_interval_seconds is clamped to 10-300 seconds. Default pid_file=~/mlai-trade/tmp/mlai-trade-daemon.pid and log_file=~/mlai-trade/logs/mlai-trade-daemon.log. Blank or relative pid/log paths are resolved inside tmp/ or logs/ so runtime files do not land in the caller's current directory. Logs rotate daily to YYYYMMDD-<log-file>.gz.

api._comment: Unix-socket API service. start refuses to run unless enabled=true. The API exposes only the allowlisted actions documented by `mlai-trade api status`; runtime is intentionally not exposed. Defaults: socket_file=~/mlai-trade/api/mlai-trade-api.sock, pid_file=~/mlai-trade/tmp/mlai-trade-api.pid, log_file=~/mlai-trade/logs/mlai-trade-api.log. Blank or relative socket/pid/log paths are resolved inside api/, tmp/, or logs/. The socket file is chmod 0600. request_timeout_seconds is for normal calls; long_request_timeout_seconds is used for ML refresh and feed sync. Overload protection returns HTTP 429 with retry_after_seconds when request rate or concurrency limits are exceeded. Logs rotate daily to YYYYMMDD-<log-file>.gz. CLI stdout/stderr wrapped by the API is redacted for configured Alpaca/FRED secrets.

logging._comment: Component JSONL logs. Empty or relative paths resolve inside ~/mlai-trade/logs and use mlai-trade-data.log, mlai-trade-ml.log, mlai-trade-training.log, and mlai-trade-feeds.log. All application logs are JSON lines, chmod 0600, and rotate daily to YYYYMMDD-<log-file>.gz.

feeds._comment: Feeds config. Pair correlations are bounded.

scan._comment: Market-data downloader controls. max_concurrent=1 is conservative for rate limits; increase only if the provider plan supports it.

backend._comment: ML backend selection. LSTM supports auto/cpu/mlx/tch. XGBoost supports auto/cpu/cuda when compiled with XGBoost support. LightGBM and Ridge are CPU-only in this Rust code today, so keep them as cpu.

resources._comment: Automatic memory/CPU safety controls. Use auto unless you need reproducible fixed caps. mlai-trade detects usable RAM from macOS sysctl, Linux host/cgroup limits, FreeBSD sysctl, or Unix sysconf fallback, then sizes ML/SQLite limits from memory_budget_percent. cpu_budget_percent is a percentage of all logical CPU capacity: 80 on 16 logical CPUs means a 1280% top-style process CPU budget. It initializes Tokio async workers plus CPU-bound Rayon/ML worker pools; GPU/NPU backends are uncapped. Numeric values override auto. Use 0/unlimited only for LightGBM row caps on hosts with enough RAM.

auto._comment: Auto-trade strategy defaults. DB auto config can override these at runtime through mlai-trade auto config, but every supported key is listed here. Default log_file=~/mlai-trade/logs/mlai-trade-auto.log. Blank or relative log_file resolves inside logs/. Auto log entries are JSON lines and include source=daemon or source=cli. Logs are chmod 0600 and rotate daily to YYYYMMDD-<log-file>.gz.

market._comment: Market clock guardrails. mode=auto uses Alpaca v3 calendar + v3 clock plus local exchange clock. mode=provider uses provider only. mode=local uses local configured schedule only. Alpaca v3 calendar is queried in UTC; timezone controls local exchange-hour guardrails and is stored with DB trade records.

compliance._comment: Hard legal/regulatory floors are compiled into the code, not configured here. blocked_symbols is user/company policy and supports multiple symbols. Input is normalized to uppercase, so meta/Meta/META all match market symbol META. IRS wash-sale days are fixed at 30. This buffer defaults to 1 and cannot be lowered below 1, so replacement buys are blocked for 31 days by default.
